errors.quote: neighbors, triples joined by side wires ($|S\cap T|=1,$ or distinct with even intersection), are orthogonal
errors.problem: The page does not say which neighbor rule belongs to which construction. In the paper, bit neighbors have |S cap T|=1 and are orthogonal under the rational form, while complex neighbors are distinct with even intersection and are orthogonal under the F_2 dot product. Read as one rule, the claim is false: over Q, triples with intersection 0 or 2 have <t_S,t_T>=-1 or 1, and over F_2, intersection 1 gives dot product 1.

The normalization is not given. The paper uses H=(1/sqrt2)[[1,1],[1,-1]], so that H^2=I and H diag(1,-1)H=X. With the usual unnormalized +-1 Hadamard matrix, C=H diag(1,i)H would be 2(aI+bX) and H diag(1,-1)H=2X, contradicting the page's later identities.
